title: Zurich — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Zurich: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Zurich has a population of 415,000. Switzerland’s largest city, a global financial hub on Lake Zurich with a stunning old town, vibrant cultural scene, and top-ranked quality of life. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 89 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
